```{r fit-subgroup-models, include=FALSE}
# Define biomarker subgroups for visualization
biomarker_defs <- list(
  list(
    name = "CRP-positive",
    var = "crp",
    pos_val = 1,
    color = "#E69F00"
  ),
  list(
    name = "CRP-negative",
    var = "crp",
    pos_val = 0,
    color = "#56B4E9"
  ),
  list(
    name = "TLR-positive",
    var = "tlr",
    pos_val = 1,
    color = "#009E73"
  ),
  list(
    name = "TLR-negative",
    var = "tlr",
    pos_val = 0,
    color = "#F0E442"
  ),
  list(
    name = "TMB/BRAF-positive",
    var = "tmb_braf",
    pos_val = 1,
    color = "#0072B2"
  ),
  list(
    name = "TMB/BRAF-negative",
    var = "tmb_braf",
    pos_val = 0,
    color = "#D55E00"
  )
)

# Use Model A joint gamma model for predictions
os_model <- models$best_fit$os
pfs_model <- models$best_fit$pfs

# Helper for population-averaged predictions
predict_pop_avg <- function(model, newdata, time_pts) {
  tryCatch({
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "survival", times = time_pts)
    if (".pred" %in% names(pred)) {
      surv_probs <- lapply(pred$.pred, function(x) x$.pred_survival)
      surv_matrix <- do.call(cbind, surv_probs)
      return(rowMeans(surv_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else if (is.list(pred) && length(pred) > 0 && is.data.frame(pred[[1]])) {
      surv_probs <- sapply(pred, function(x) x$est)
      if (is.matrix(surv_probs)) return(rowMeans(surv_probs, na.rm = TRUE))
      else return(surv_probs)
    }
    return(NULL)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Extract KM data helper
extract_km_data <- function(km_fit) {
  data.frame(time = km_fit$time, surv = km_fit$surv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
```

```{r create-panels, include=FALSE}
panels <- list()

for (bm_def in biomarker_defs) {
  # Subset data for this biomarker subgroup
  bm_mask <- as.numeric(as.character(data_complete[[bm_def$var]])) == bm_def$pos_val
  subgroup_data <- data_complete[bm_mask, ]

  if (nrow(subgroup_data) < 3) next

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    panel_key <- paste0(bm_def$name, "_", outcome)
    outcome_label <- if (outcome == "os") "Overall Survival" else "Progression-Free Survival"

    # Kaplan-Meier for this subgroup
    if (outcome == "os") {
      km_fit <- survfit(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ 1, data = subgroup_data)
    } else {
      km_fit <- survfit(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ 1, data = subgroup_data)
    }
    km_df <- extract_km_data(km_fit)

    # Parametric prediction for this subgroup (using Model A)
    model_obj <- if (outcome == "os") os_model else pfs_model
    # Predict with actual treatment assignment
    param_pred <- predict_pop_avg(model_obj, subgroup_data, time_points)

    if (is.null(param_pred)) next

    pred_df <- data.frame(time = time_points, surv = param_pred)

    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_step(data = km_df, aes(x = time, y = surv),
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = time, y = surv),
                color = bm_def$color, linewidth = 0.8) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = seq(0, max(time_points), by = 104),
        labels = function(x) x / 52
      ) +
      labs(x = "Time (years)", y = outcome_label,
           title = paste0(bm_def$name, " (n=", nrow(subgroup_data), ")")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 7)
      )

    panels[[panel_key]] <- p
  }
}

cat("Generated", length(panels), "panels\n")
```

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
# Arrange panels: 6 subgroups x 2 outcomes = 12 panels
# Layout: 6 rows (one per subgroup) x 2 columns (OS, PFS)

panel_order <- c()
for (bm_def in biomarker_defs) {
  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    panel_order <- c(panel_order, paste0(bm_def$name, "_", outcome))
  }
}

# Filter to available panels
available_panels <- panel_order[panel_order %in% names(panels)]
panel_list <- panels[available_panels]

if (length(panel_list) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = panel_list,
    ncol = 2,
    labels = LETTERS[1:length(panel_list)],
    label_size = 10
  )

  # Add legend annotation
  legend_text <- "Black step: Kaplan-Meier observed data. Colored line: Gamma parametric fit (Model A)."

  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    combined_plot,
    ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = legend_text,
                        size = 3.5, hjust = 0.5) + theme_void(),
    ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.03)
  )

  print(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (length(panel_list) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure_s1.png"),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 14,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure_s1.png"), "\n")
}
```
